display.purpose: Hero headlines only. Two lines maximum.

title.purpose: Card headings, product names, UI labels.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, step numbers, tags, form labels. Metadata only.

shadows.name: glass-identity
shadows.purpose: Nav bar on scroll and identity glass elements only.

motion.name: ease-state

breakpoints.name: mobile

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action. One per section maximum.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; background: #FF6B47; color: #F5F6FA; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 48px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,107,71,0.35); transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FF8A6B; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(255,107,71,0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF6B47; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Never competes with primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; background: transparent; color: #F5F6FA; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 48px; transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #FF6B47; color: #FF6B47; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF6B47; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Table Grid Cell
components.description: The signature HICKS content cell. Used in Méthode, Solutions, Offres grids. Flat, no shadow.
components.html:
01

Audit IA

Cartographie de vos processus et identification des gains rapides.

Forfait fixe · Livrable garanti
components.css: .ds-grid-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-grid-cell { background: #0A1428; padding: 28px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-grid-cell:hover { background: rgba(15,30,61,0.95); } .ds-grid-num { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; color: #FF6B47; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-grid-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #F5F6FA; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-grid-body { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #8892A4; } .ds-grid-tag { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(255,107,71,0.5); text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: auto; }

components.name: Form Input Field
components.description: Always with visible label. Placeholder is hint, not label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { padding: 13px 18px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: #F5F6FA; font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(255,107,71,0.5); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(136,146,164,0.4); }

components.name: Hero Badge
components.description: Availability signal in the hero. Coral pulse dot + Space Mono text.
components.css: .ds-hero-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 16px; background: rgba(255,107,71,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,107,71,0.22); border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #FF6B47; width: fit-content; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #FF6B47; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; animation: ds-pulse 2s ease infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-badge-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: Space Mono label above every section headline. Activation Coral, uppercase.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FF6B47; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Product Name Tag
components.description: Product naming pattern: prefix + X suffix in Activation Coral.
components.css: .ds-product-name { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.18rem; font-weight: 700; color: #F5F6FA; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1; } .ds-product-x { color: #FF6B47; }

narrative.overview:
HICKS is the visual language of someone who has spent 22 years inside systems, not selling them. Every surface communicates controlled precision: a clean grid, a restrained palette, a single accent that fires only when it matters. Nothing decorative survives. What remains is a dark, structured environment that makes a PME director feel they are looking at a dashboard of expertise, not a marketing brochure.

The Command Navy background is the load-bearing wall. It absorbs 80% of every viewport. Activation Coral is the signal: it appears on CTAs, active labels, and the logo. Used anywhere else, it loses its authority. Console Grey carries secondary text: readable, professional, never dominant.

This system explicitly rejects the startup hype register. No purple gradients. No glassmorphism grids. No hero-metric templates. No identical card grids. The SaaS-cream-and-violet palette is forbidden.
keyCharacteristics: Activation Coral at maximum 10-15% of any viewport
Table-grid sections instead of raised cards for content grids
Space Mono labels as metadata signal, not decoration
Human presence (photo, narrative bio) anchors identity surfaces
Glass effects reserved for nav and identity only

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Activation Coral is used on 10-15% of any given viewport maximum. Every new coral element displaces an existing one. Its rarity is its authority.

rules.name: The No-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Color conveys function: surface, signal, or text. If a color element does not communicate state, hierarchy, or action, remove it.

rules.name: The Mono-as-Metadata Rule
rules.body: Space Mono appears on section eyebrows, step numbers, product tags, form labels, the cred strip. It never appears on paragraphs or content longer than one line.

rules.name: The Negative-Track Rule
rules.body: Display and Headline headings always carry negative letter-spacing (-0.025em to -0.035em). Tight tracking on dark backgrounds prevents letter gaps from reading as noise.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on glass identity elements (nav, logo). A content card that needs a shadow to feel elevated is not elevated enough by its content.

rules.name: The Glass-Identity Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur() appears only on nav-scrolled state and logo contexts. Never on content grids or pricing sections. Glass on content grids = SaaS cliché.

dos: Do use Command Navy (#0A1428) as the default cell background inside table grids
Do apply Activation Coral exclusively to interactive affordances: CTAs, active labels, hover accents
Do use Space Mono for metadata: section eyebrows, step numbers, form labels, product tags
Do use text-wrap: balance on all headings
Do include visible <label for> elements on every form field
Do reserve backdrop-filter: blur() for nav-scrolled state and identity glass only
Do keep negative letter-spacing on all Display and Headline text
Do apply prefers-reduced-motion to all reveal animations
donts: Don't use SaaS générique violet/blanc (Notion, Webflow template, Linear clone aesthetics)
Don't use glassmorphism on content grids (Méthode, Solutions, Offres cells)
Don't build hero-metric templates: big number + small label + gradient accent
Don't build identical card grids (icon + heading + text, same size, repeated)
Don't place gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient)
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as colored accent)
Don't add Activation Coral beyond 15% of the viewport
Don't use startup hype copy (ROI, disruption, scale)
Don't add more than one primary CTA per section
Don't build banking ultra-corporate visual language (Capgemini, McKinsey Digital)
